pastDue.body: Ubwishyu bwa nyuma bw'ishuri ryanyu ntibwagenze neza. Bwishyure kugira ngo mutabura uburenganzira bwo gukoresha.

readOnly.body: Murashobora gusoma no gukuramo ibintu byose nk'uko bisanzwe, ariko nta gishya gishobora kubikwa kugeza konti y'ishuri yishyuwe. Vugana n'ibiro by'ishuri ryanyu.
